description: Source code for map calculation in IPv6 network configuration, including functions for prefix matching, byte manipulation, and rule processing.

methods.name: bmemcmp
methods.description: Compares bits of two memory regions, considering partial bits at the end.

methods.name: bmemcpy
methods.description: Copies bits from one memory region to another, handling partial bits.

methods.name: bmemcpys64
methods.description: Copies bits from one memory region to another, using a 64-bit buffer for efficiency.

methods.name: handle_dump
methods.description: Handles dump requests, parsing and storing interface dump data.

methods.name: match_prefix
methods.description: Matches IPv6 prefixes against a list of interface attributes, updating prefix length and address accordingly.
